inventory_pair_constraint.definition: CHECK ((((inventory_source IS NULL) AND (source_key IS NULL)) OR ((inventory_source IS NOT NULL) AND ((inventory_source)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['documents'::character varying, 'uploads'::character varying, 'chunks'::character varying, 'items'::character varying, 'secrets'::character varying, 'obligations'::character varying, 'reminders'::character varying, 'notifications'::character varying, 'notification-deliveries'::character varying, 'outbox'::character varying, 'deliveries'::character varying, 'inbox'::character varying, 'scans'::character varying, 'scan-attempts'::character varying, 'auth-challenges'::character varying, 'stripe-bindings'::character varying, 'stripe-notices'::character varying, 'stripe-states'::character varying, 'export-artifacts'::character varying])::text[])) AND (source_key IS NOT NULL) AND ((source_key)::text ~ '^[a-f0-9-]{1,40}$'::text) AND (inventory_count = 1))))

account_billing_constraints.name: stripe_test_states_check
account_billing_constraints.definition:
CHECK ((((state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'canceling'::text, 'grace'::text])) AND (premium_until IS NOT NULL) AND (paid_through IS NOT NULL) AND (premium_until <= (paid_through +
CASE
    WHEN (state = 'grace'::text) THEN 604800
    ELSE 0
END))) OR ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::text, 'canceling'::text, 'grace'::text])) AND (premium_until IS NULL))))
